title: Mukden Palace
limitations: The Dazheng and ten Banner Pavilions, Chongzheng Hall, Daqing Gate, Phoenix Tower and Wensu Library are exterior reconstructions. Subsidiary halls and gallery roof profiles are approximated within their mapped outlines.
PMTiles footprints and standard Terrarium grades set placement. Step, retaining wall and historic courtyard elevations are estimated from photographs. Interior rooms are outside the model scope.
